purpose: offline design only; write only during separately approved sandboxed installation
ownership_rule: Persist PREPARED expected sha256/uid/mode for every target before any replace. The expiry preimage UID must equal the executing installer UID: this per-user harness has no fchown restore path. Persist WRITING before and COMMITTED after each replace. Rollback only mutates a path if its current bytes, uid, and mode match its receipt-owned expected content.
